app_tagline: Offline Currency Assistant for Blind & Visually Impaired
home_start_scan_hint: Double tap to activate rear camera and begin currency recognition
home_empty_wallet: Wallet is empty. Total is zero rupees.
home_voice_hint: Tap Voice Command button or say 'What can I say?' for available commands
onboarding_welcome_desc: NayanSaathi helps you independently recognize Indian currency notes and calculate cash totals completely offline without internet.
onboarding_tutorial_step1: Place your banknote on a flat, well-lit surface.
onboarding_tutorial_step2: Hold your phone about 8 to 12 inches above the note with the camera facing down.
onboarding_tutorial_step3: Keep the phone steady. The app will speak the detected denomination automatically.
onboarding_tutorial_step4: Uncertain notes are never added to your cash total.
onboarding_perm_desc: NayanSaathi requires Camera permission to scan notes and Microphone permission to accept voice commands. All audio and images stay strictly on your phone.
scanner_status_ready: Camera ready. Point at an Indian currency note.
scanner_status_paused: Scanning paused. Double tap to resume.
guidance_move_center: Move the note into the center.
guidance_move_farther: Move the phone slightly farther away.
guidance_move_closer: Move the phone closer to the note.
guidance_too_dark: The lighting is too dark. Turn on flashlight if needed.
guidance_flatten_note: Please flatten or unwrinkle the note.
guidance_separate_notes: Notes are overlapping. Please separate them.
guidance_uncertain: I could not identify the note confidently. Please adjust position and try again.
wallet_total_announcement: Current total is %{total} rupees from %{count} notes.
wallet_added_note: Added %{denomination} rupees. Total is now %{total} rupees.
wallet_added_multi: Added %{count} notes. Total is now %{total} rupees.
wallet_undo_success: Undone last addition of %{amount} rupees. New total is %{total} rupees.
wallet_undo_empty: Nothing to undo. Wallet is empty.
wallet_clear_prompt: Are you sure you want to clear your wallet total of %{total} rupees? This cannot be undone.
wallet_cleared: Cash wallet cleared. Total is now zero rupees.
wallet_empty_state: No notes added yet in this session.
split_desc: Divide the current wallet total of %{total} rupees among a group of people.
split_result_announcement: The total is %{total} rupees. Each person receives %{share} rupees. The remaining amount is %{remainder} rupees.
split_zero_wallet_error: Cannot split cash. Your wallet total is zero rupees. Scan some notes first.
voice_unrecognized: I did not understand that command. Say 'What can I say?' to hear available commands.
voice_offline_notice: Offline voice recognition is ready on your device.
voice_offline_limited: Offline speech recognition is unavailable in this language. Manual accessible controls are active.
model_missing: Offline Model Not Installed. Please follow installation guide.
